## florence-shopper-review-mining

**Skill:** /shopper-interrogator (Skill 3)
**Trigger:** POST webhook with `x-florence-secret` header

**Input shape (request body):**
```json
{ "asin": "B07XYZ4231", "competitors": ["B08AAA0001", "B08BBB0002"] }
```

**Output shape:**
```json
{ "asin": "B07XYZ4231", "objections": [{ "source_asin": "...", "quote": "...", "stars": 1, "frequency": 12 }] }
```

**External dependency:** Amazon scrape MCP. Replace the URL in *Call Amazon Scrape MCP* with your endpoint. Latency target <90s for 5 competitors.
